paragraphs: ÚGJÜ RADIO is an ear inside a house, listening from the half-open door.
Sometimes silence is also part of the transmission.
Here, radio does not broadcast scheduled shows.
A forgotten record, an undated tape, jamming, a conversation, rain, someone tuning an instrument, or a work that does not yet know what it wants to be may appear.
We do not want to guess what you want to listen to.
We do not want to turn music into recommendations.
We are not a service, a platform, or an algorithm.
A place for music that cannot find a stable home.
We believe in rehearsals, accidents, imperfect recordings, and ideas that are still being born.
We do not want recordings to die inside a hard drive.
To encounter other music and become part of the present once more.
Perhaps you will enter today and something will be happening.
The door will still be there.
ÚGJÜ RADIO is a project within ÚGJÜ SECTAS.
